note: Records without their own source: DIU's CSE Class Routine V4.1 (effective 3 Oct 2026, the newest on DIU's notice board on 2026-10-19), parsed from its PDF; 1,961 class slots, every course token in the PDF accounted for, no room double-booked and no teacher in two rooms at once. Records citing diu-swe-routine-263-v5: Software Engineering's Fall 2026 routine V5 (effective 10 Oct 2026), parsed from its Excel file; rooms as SWE prints them (lab tags dropped, no building guessed), online classes with no room. In the 14 G1 computer labs both use, CSE and SWE never book a room at the same hour. Records citing diu-eng-routine-263-v07: the Department of English's Fall 2026 class schedule V-0.7 (14 Oct 2026), parsed from its Excel file; its 50 empty "Tutorial" slots are not classes and are left out; a retake class the routine prints with two codes (old curriculum and new) is a record for each, noting the pairing. Only these three departments' routines are here, and DIU's departments name rooms in incompatible ways, so this file cannot answer which rooms are free. A section is DIU's batch-section as printed ("68_D", lab groups "69_O1", retake sections "RE_A(3C)" with their credit tag); a mistyped name (a stray full stop, a missing bracket) is corrected with a note on the record. Consecutive slots of one section in one room are merged (a lab's two 90-minute slots become one meeting). Teachers are DIU's initials as printed; NT-n and EEE-1 / EEE_1 are placeholders the routine uses, kept as printed. Where two teachers share a section, faculty is null and the note names each. DIU publishes no section sizes or seats.
